item.title: After fires, officials prepare to remove another homeless encampment on Chicago’s Northwest Side
item.description: <p>Snow and ice covered Carmen Laude’s wheelchair. A mattress, turned upright, served as the front door of her tent in Legion Park, which straddles a mile of the Chicago River on the Northwest Side.</p><p>Inside the tent, Laude, 72, cooked soup over a propane-powered stove.
